Ejemplo
Español

blocks.title: in case = por si, no 'en caso de que'
blocks.text: in case = por si (una precaución): Take a coat in case it gets cold (llévate un abrigo por si hace frío). Para en caso de que o si se usa if: If it gets cold, put on a coat. Y siempre que en el sentido de condición es provided that o as long as, nunca always that.
En el inglés académico y profesional casi nunca se hacen afirmaciones absolutas. Se suavizan con el hedging.

blocks.title: Hedging
items: en la mayoría de los casos

blocks.title: Más suave de lo que crees
blocks.text: Esto está mal o Esto es incorrecto suena a menudo demasiado duro en inglés. Mejor This may not be entirely correct o I'm not sure this is quite right. En una redacción: This suggests that ... en lugar de This proves that ...

head: Función
Frases
rows: This essay will examine ... The aim of this section is to ...
To begin with ... Turning now to ... Lastly ...
In other words ... That is to say ... To put it simply ...
For instance ... A case in point is ... This is illustrated by ...
To sum up ... In short ... All things considered ...
Nevertheless the rain, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
nevertheless no va delante de un sustantivo.
Take an umbrella in case of it rains.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
Owing to the strike, we stayed.
You can borrow it provided you will return it.
You can borrow it provided you return it.
This suggests that most people agree.
Whereas I agree, I have doubts.
While I agree, I have doubts.

items.q: The plan is expensive. ______, we will go ahead.
items.full: The plan is expensive. Nevertheless, we will go ahead.

items.q: My brother loves sport, ______ I prefer reading.
items.full: My brother loves sport, whereas I prefer reading.

items.q: ______ to the bad weather, the match was postponed.
items.full: Owing to the bad weather, the match was postponed.

items.q: You can use my car ______ that you drive carefully.
items.full: You can use my car provided that you drive carefully.

items.q: Take some money in ______ you need a taxi.
items.full: Take some money in case you need a taxi.

items.q: Sales fell sharply. ______, the company cut jobs.
items.full: Sales fell sharply. Consequently, the company cut jobs.
Admittedly, the results are not perfect.

items.q: Young people ______ to spend more time online.
items.full: Young people tend to spend more time online.

items.q: In other ______, the project has failed.
items.full: In other words, the project has failed.

items.q: All things ______, it was a successful year.
items.full: All things considered, it was a successful year.

items.q: Llévate un abrigo por si hace frío.
items.a: Take a coat in case it gets cold.

items.q: Parece que los precios están subiendo.
items.a: It seems that prices are rising.

items.q: Puedes irte siempre que termines antes tu trabajo.
items.a: You can go, provided that you finish your work first.

items.q: Teniéndolo todo en cuenta, fue un buen año.
items.a: All things considered, it was a good year.
